Relax at this private 30A beach cottage with a free golf cart, a spacious fenced yard, and a private garage gym, located just 0.4 miles from the beach.

Designed for effortless beach days and relaxed evenings, this single-level coastal retreat offers rare space, privacy, and amenities along Scenic 30A. Set on over half an acre, the home is ideal for families, couples, and guests who want easy access to the beach without stairs, crowds, or compromises.

Guest Favorites

• Walk, bike, or ride the complimentary 6-seat LSV to the beach (0.4 miles)
• FREE golf cart for stress-free beach access
• Fully fenced private backyard
• Private garage gym (rare 30A amenity)
• Fire pit, bikes, and paddleboards included
• Single-level home with no stairs
• Wine fridge and coffee bar
• Screened patio and gas grill

Location

Located in Inlet Beach, between Lake Powell and the Gulf of Mexico, this home offers a peaceful setting with quick access to the best of 30A.

Enjoy a bike or golf-cart ride to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach via the US-98 pedestrian underpass, or explore dining and shopping at 30Avenue.

The Space

• 3 bedrooms | 2 full bathrooms | Sleeps 8
• Single-level layout with no stairs or elevators
• Over half an acre of private, fully fenced outdoor space

Kitchen and Coffee Bar

• Fully stocked kitchen with full-size appliances
• Wine fridge
• Keurig, drip coffee maker, and French press
• Organic coffee and teas
• Cookware, dishes, wine glasses, and utensils
• Starter paper goods and dish supplies
• Complimentary beverages

Dining Areas

• Family dining table
• Breakfast table
• Seating for eight or more guests

Living Area

• Open, comfortable living space
• Wood-burning fireplace
• 65-inch Google Smart TV
• Sonos surround sound system
• Board games, puzzles, and arts and crafts supplies
• Stream music directly from your phone

Sleeping Arrangements

Primary Suite
• King bed
• Smart TV
• En-suite bathroom with soaking tub and walk-in shower

Bedroom Two
• Queen bed
• Smart TV

Bedroom Three – Bunk Room
• Twin-over-full bunk
• Twin trundle
• Fold-out chair converting to a twin bed (sleeps five)
• Smart TV

Bathrooms

• Two full bathrooms (one en-suite, one shared)
• Hair dryer
• Towels and essential toiletries provided
• “Forgot Something” convenience baskets (not restocked)

Laundry Room

• Washer and dryer
• Hypoallergenic detergent and dryer sheets
• Iron and garment steamer

Outdoor Living

• Large, fully fenced backyard
• Fire pit with Adirondack chairs and firewood
• Screened patio with dining and lounge seating
• Gas grill and Green Egg smoker
• Outdoor shower
• Four adult beach cruiser bikes (helmets not provided)
• Two paddleboards (life vests not provided)
• Beach chairs, toys, and gear available with advance notice

Private Garage Gym (Guest-Only)

A rare 30A amenity featuring:
• NordicTrack treadmill
• Schwinn IC3 stationary bike
• Marcy multi-station weight machine
• Free weights and adjustable bench
• Yoga mats
• Sonos sound system

Private garage-based gym. Not a commercial facility. Guests must be 18 or older or supervised.

Entertainment and Technology

• Fast Wi-Fi
• Smart TVs in every bedroom
• Indoor and outdoor Sonos sound system

Security

• Ring doorbell at front entry
• Exterior cameras at cottage corners only
• No interior or private-area cameras
• Cameras used solely for safety and insurance compliance

Extras

• Oversized private parking
• On-site Tesla charger
• FREE six-seat LSV (golf cart)
• Driver must be 25 or older with signed agreement
• Luggage drop-off available upon request
• Early arrival or late departure available as a half-day add-on

Concierge Services

• Birthday and anniversary celebration setups available by advance arrangement

Rental Agreement and Damage Protection

• Rental agreement required within 48 hours of booking per Walton County regulations (LDC §1.13.16.G)
• Accidental damage protection up to $1,000 included
• Does not cover intentional damage or gross negligence

30A Beach Cottage offers a vacation experience most homes simply cannot.

Questions before booking are always welcome.
